# ADHDclearfocus

> ADHDclearfocus is an educational ADHD self-awareness and productivity platform operated by Focused Care Psychology Limited. It does not diagnose ADHD and does not create a clinical relationship.

Canonical site: https://www.adhdclearfocus.com/
Last updated: 2026-09-03

## Important scope
The 39-question ADHDclearfocus profile is an educational self-awareness tool, not a validated diagnostic test. Scores describe self-reported difficulty within the tool and do not establish diagnosis, severity or treatment need. Formal diagnosis requires assessment by an appropriately qualified clinician.

## Editorial approach
Health claims should be traceable to peer-reviewed research, major clinical guidelines or established consensus statements. Preliminary or mixed evidence is labelled accordingly. Research content is prepared by the ADHDclearfocus editorial team and clinically reviewed through Focused Care Psychology.
